description: Street-level computer vision: the Image Segmentation node labels every pixel of street photos with a model from the Model Catalog, and reports each class's share of every image. Images come from the Data or Discovery Catalog (Mapillary, Google Street View); models from the Model Catalog, where DDRNet23-Slim ships with Curio and Hugging Face models are added from the Discovery Catalog.
name: Street Vision

templates.description: Label every pixel of each image with a Model Catalog model: drag a model onto the node to choose it. Input: a collection's rows, each with a path (Data Loading on street-level images). Output: the same rows with one column per class asked for (its share of the image's pixels, in percent), dominant_class, dominant_pct and an overlay_url a Simple View shows.
templates.label: Image Segmentation
